title: Successive rightward cascades
statement: For every natural number $\ell$, every $j\in\mathbb{N}$, and every configuration of $\ell$ zones, the rightward cascade of length $j+1$ is obtained by applying one paired zone shift at level $j+1$, then the length-$j$ rightward cascade, then another paired shift at level $j+1$.
